paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.14 as of September 22, 2026, representing a 3.21 percent increase from the prior close and an 8.54 percent decrease over the last 20 trading sessions. There have been 3 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi and TensorWave agreeing to extend the closing date of a lease by a month, a discussion on why retail investors remain bullish on FRMI stock despite the company having zero revenue and a significant loss, and a report on an escalating governance dispute with a lawsuit. These news items were reported by Seeking Alpha, Stocktwits, and Intellectia AI, respectively.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings, which report insider transactions, and 7 proxy solicitation filings.
